message: So, I was hanging out with my friend Tim the other day, and of course, he started panicking about the smoke alarm going off during our pizza night. I couldn't help but laugh a little because he always goes straight to the worst-case scenario. But it did remind me how important it is to have a plan. We chatted about our escape routes and even practiced a little. It felt good to know we were ready for anything, even if Tim might still freak out over a little smoke. Do you have a plan with your friends or family?
